note: M3 plan §3.A: the options-overlay registry lane. Each overlay is pinned to its parent equity world (registry.json spec, regenerated and manifest-verified first), to its OptionsOverlaySpec (seeds/knobs — never rewritten by the verifier), and to the generating code (synth_options_code_sha over every synth_options/*.py byte — re-pinned ONLY by an explicit verify_options_worlds.py --recompute).
